caption: The drawing features a garment, specifically a capelet, depicted in two views on a plain beige background. The central view shows the front of the capelet, which is patterned with a dense, repeating geometric or floral motif in black and white. The capelet is edged with a solid dark border along the opening and hem. The neckline is simple and round, sitting close to the neck. Underneath the cape, faint pencil lines suggest the outline of a dress or gown worn beneath. To the upper right side of the main image is a smaller, outlined sketch showing the back view of the capelet. This secondary sketch is uncolored and provides additional information about the garment’s shape and construction. No human figures or facial features are present; only the garment and its schematic outline are shown.
title: Cape
